The user said appointments were hard to get and asked how to get a gastroenterology appointment faster.

The user said the symptoms were embarrassing to discuss and later described arriving feeling ashamed.

output.summary: The user described ulcerative colitis symptoms including sudden urgency, frequent bowel movements, and occasional blood that disrupted work and family life, and said they had believed this was normal while taking mesalamine. The assistant discussed specialist follow-up, possible treatment questions, calprotectin testing, coping strategies, and checking with a doctor before using loperamide. The user ended feeling less ashamed and said they had a plan and could take action.
